modeReason: Several top stories independently clear the relevance threshold of 8 (datacenter backlash at 18; OpenAI safety exits, the chip-smuggling arrest, Apple's agent lockdown, and the nurse-scheduling harms each at 8), so today stands on its own rather than needing to continue yesterday's thread.
phrase: A cloud company spent a billion dollars calming angry neighbors near its datacenters. A hospital's new AI scheduler is calming nobody, least of all the nurses.
phraseAlternatives: A company spent a billion dollars trying to calm its datacenter neighbors. A hospital's scheduling program could not calm a single nurse.
Datacenters got camouflage netting and a billion-dollar apology this week. Nurses just got a worse schedule.
One story this week involved $300 million in smuggled chips. Another involved a nurse who just wanted a schedule that made sense.
This week a government renamed artificial intelligence. The nurses whose shifts it scrambles still just call it a headache.

brief.concept: A datacenter hides behind a leafy camouflage screen while a small crowd holds blank signs outside it, and beside that panel a tired nurse studies a shift chart as a small robot hand crosses out a row in red.
brief.metaphor: Hiding the machine from the neighbors is easier than fixing the schedule for the people who work next to it.
cast: a datacenter wrapped in leafy camouflage netting
a small crowd of generic humans holding blank protest signs
a tired nurse in scrubs looking at a shift schedule chart
a small robot hand crossing out a shift row in red
brief.composition: Split vertical composition divided by a thin paper seam. Left half: a boxy datacenter shape wrapped in cut-paper leaf shapes, a small meter below it labeled CALM with the needle low, three plain human silhouettes with blank signs standing at its base. Right half: a nurse figure standing beside a tall chart of shift rows, a tiny robot arm reaching in to cross out one row with a red paper strip. Soft drop shadows under every layer, kraft card background, no outlines.
brief.alt: A split illustration: on one side, a datacenter disguised with leafy camouflage stands before a small crowd holding blank signs, with a calm-meter reading low. On the other side, a tired nurse looks at a shift schedule chart where a small robotic hand is crossing out a row in red.
